name: Rythu Bharosa Scheme (Telangana)
benefit: ₹15,000 per acre / year direct benefit transfer (DBT) to farmers & tenant farmers + ₹500 bonus per quintal for fine paddy
description: Flagship agricultural input assistance providing ₹15,000/acre annually to landowning farmers and verified tenant farmers across Telangana for crop cultivation.

name: Maha Lakshmi Scheme (Telangana 6 Guarantees)
benefit: ₹2,500 monthly financial assistance + LPG cylinder at ₹500 + 100% Free TSRTC bus travel across Telangana
required_documents: Telangana Food Security Card (White Ration Card)
description: Empowering women across Telangana with ₹2,500 monthly direct cash transfers, subsidized cooking gas cylinders at ₹500, and free travel in TSRTC Palle Velugu and Express buses.

name: Gruha Jyothi (200 Units Free Power)
nameHindi: गृह ज्योति योजना (200 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली)
nameTelugu: గృహ జ్యోతి (200 యూనిట్ల ఉచిత గృహ విద్యుత్)
benefit: Up to 200 units of completely FREE domestic electricity per month for all eligible white ration card households (zero bill)
required_documents: Latest TGSPDCL / TGNPDCL Electricity Meter Bill
description: State guarantee delivering up to 200 units of free power each billing cycle to residential consumers, protecting vulnerable families from utility inflation.

name: Indiramma Indlu (Housing Scheme)
nameTelugu: ఇందిరమ్మ ఇండ్లు (₹5 లక్షల గృహ నిర్మాణ పథకం)
benefit: ₹5,00,000 direct construction assistance in 4 stages for homeless families owning a plot + Free house site for landless poor
required_documents: Plot Title Deed / Gram Kantham Certificate
description: Transforming rural and semi-urban shelter by providing ₹5 lakh direct financial aid to construct durable pucca houses with sanitation facilities.

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri Telangana
nameTelugu: రాజీవ్ ఆరోగ్యశ్రీ (₹10 లక్షల ఉచిత ఆరోగ్య భద్రత)
benefit: ₹10,00,000 per family per year comprehensive cashless hospitalization coverage across 1,375 empanelled hospitals
required_documents: Aarogyasri Health Card / Praja Palana ID
description: Comprehensive state health protection ceiling doubled to ₹10 Lakhs, covering 1,672 critical medical and surgical therapies with zero out-of-pocket costs.

name: Cheyutha / Aasara Social Security Pension
benefit: ₹4,000 monthly direct pension for senior citizens (57+ yrs), widows, beedi workers, weavers, toddy tappers; ₹6,000/mo for disabled
description: Dignified social security pension ensuring monthly living stipends credited directly to senior citizens, widows, and vulnerable occupational groups.

name: Yuva Vikasam (Vidya Bharosa Card)
nameTelugu: యువ వికాసం (₹5 లక్షల విద్యా భరోసా కార్డ్)
benefit: ₹5,00,000 Vidya Bharosa financial aid card for higher education, competitive coaching, and university fees + Telangana International Schools
description: Higher education scholarship and guarantee card enabling underprivileged students to access professional engineering, medicine, and degree courses.

name: Kalyana Lakshmi & Shaadi Mubarak
nameTelugu: కళ్యాణ లక్ష్మి / షాదీ ముబారక్ (₹1,00,116 వివాహ సహాయం)
benefit: ₹1,00,116 one-time direct bank transfer for the marriage of brides belonging to SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority families
description: Pioneering financial support initiative eliminating child marriage and preventing family indebtedness by providing direct monetary wedding grants.

name: Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi
nameTelugu: అంబేద్కర్ ఓవర్సీస్ విద్యా నిధి (విదేశీ విద్యకు ₹20 లక్షల గ్రాంట్)
benefit: Up to ₹20,00,000 grant for SC, ST, BC, and Minority students pursuing Master's / Ph.D. degrees in top international universities
description: Substantial financial scholarship empowering ambitious Telangana students to pursue postgraduate degrees in USA, UK, Canada, Germany, and Australia.

name: Telangana Nethanna Bima & Handloom Subsidy
nameTelugu: నేతన్న బీమా పథకం (చేనేత కార్మికులకు ₹5 లక్షల బీమా)
benefit: ₹5,00,000 life insurance coverage on par with Rythu Bima + 50% yarn subsidy for handloom and powerloom weavers
description: Comprehensive socio-economic safety net providing ₹5 lakh insurance payout to weaver families in case of natural or accidental demise.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (Telangana Convergence)
benefit: ₹6,000 / year direct cash transfer in 3 installments of ₹2,000 converging with Rythu Bharosa
description: Central income support for small and marginal landholding farmer families, synchronized with Telangana Rythu Bharosa DBT pipeline.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (TGSPDCL / TGNPDCL)
nameHindi: प्रधानमंत्री सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना (तेलंगाना)
nameTelugu: పీఎం సూర్య ఘర్: ఉచిత సౌర విద్యుత్ పథకం
benefit: Up to ₹78,000 direct capital subsidy for 3kW rooftop solar + TGSPDCL net-metering grid export credits
description: Central-state collaborative solar initiative offering direct capital subsidies to households generating rooftop solar power across Telangana.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme (Telangana Crafts)
benefit: ₹15,000 modern toolkit e-voucher + Collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest
required_documents: Skill Trade Proof / Gram Panchayat Endorsement
description: End-to-end holistic support for Telangana carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, sculptors, and weavers with modern toolkits and micro-credit.
